title: SwiftStable
tagline: A global financial platform that enables seamless conversion and withdrawal of stablecoins across borders.
description: A platform offering global stablecoin conversion with AI Agents optimizing transactions and liquidity decisions in real time. Using Coinbase for on-ramp (fiat to stablecoin integration) and Unlimit for international withdrawals, the platform ensures users can convert stablecoins (like USDC) into local currencies (e.g., euros) securely and automatically.
how_its_made:
Key Features:

	•	Coinbase On-Ramp: Direct fiat-to-stablecoin conversion for seamless access to stablecoins.
	•	Unlimit: Supports global withdrawals and transfers to international banks.
	•	AI Agents: Real-time optimization of liquidity, asset allocation, and transaction efficiency.
	•	XMTP: Integrated communication to provide transaction and liquidity updates directly to users’ devices.
